## About this meetup

This is BRUG's soft opening — an informal first gathering to meet the community 
and lay out what we are building together. No prior BRUG experience required 
(obviously). Show up, say hello, and tell us what you code.

## Details

- **Date:** Monday, July 7, 2026
- **Time:** 1:00 – 3:00 PM
- **Location:** CS 3139, Computer Science Building, UW–Madison

## Agenda

**Meet and Greet** — introductions, coffee, the usual. We want to know who is 
in the room and what brings you here.

**The Burrows** — a walkthrough of BRUG's new community website, where we will 
host resources, tools, tutorials, and presentations. The site lives on GitHub 
and is built so that contributing is as simple as opening a pull request — 
which is itself a small lesson in reproducible workflow.

**Demo: reproducible project setup** — a live walkthrough of 
[toolero](https://github.com/erwinlares/toolero) focused on project structure, 
documentation habits, and best practices that make your work easier to share, 
revisit, and build on.

## Who should come

Anyone who writes R code at UW–Madison — grad students, postdocs, staff 
researchers, faculty, or curious undergrads. Bring your laptop if you want to 
follow along with the demo.
